content.myth: “IPMAT Short Answer questions have negative marking.”
content.detail: A wrong SA answer costs you nothing. So a skipped SA question is a free chance missed: if you have worked out an answer, enter it.

caption:
Myth: IPMAT Indore Short Answer questions have negative marking.
Fact: SA questions carry no negative marking, so a skipped SA question is a free chance missed.

Always check the official IPMAT notification for the latest marking scheme.
